teaser.en: A pod of sesame holds dozens of tiny seeds, and together they bring both cooking oil and cash to dry farms.
teaser.sw: Ganda moja la ufuta hubeba mbegu ndogo nyingi, na kwa pamoja huleta mafuta ya kupikia na pesa katika mashamba makavu.
teaser.dg: Kakaya mwenga ra *ufuha* rina tembe ndide nyinji sana, na phamwenga zinareha mafuha ga kujitira na pesa kpwa minda ya tsi kavu.

summary.en: *Ufuha* is sesame or simsim, an upright herb grown for its small oily seeds. It is a cash crop of the drier farms and a source of cooking oil.
summary.sw: *Ufuha* ni ufuta, mmea mdogo uliosimama unaolimwa kwa ajili ya mbegu zake ndogo zenye mafuta. Ni zao la biashara la mashamba makavu na chanzo cha mafuta ya kupikia.
summary.dg: *Ufuha* (kpwa Chingereza *sesame* au *simsim*) ni mmea uimao chocho, unaorimwa kpwa sababu ya tembeze ndide zenye mafuha. Ni mmea wa kuguza ili kuphaha pesa kpwenye minda ya tsi kavu, na nkulavya mafuha ga kujitira.

about.en:
*Ufuha* is an upright herb that grows to about head height, with soft leaves and tubular, bell-shaped flowers in white or pale pink along the stem.

The flowers are followed by upright, four-sided pods packed with tiny, flat seeds. When ripe and dry, the pods split open, so the crop must be cut at the right time.

Digo farmers grow two named varieties, *ufuha mwiru* and *ufuha mwereru*.
about.sw:
*Ufuha* ni mmea mdogo uliosimama unaokua hadi karibu kimo cha kichwa cha mtu, wenye majani laini na maua yenye umbo la neli na kengele, meupe au ya waridi hafifu, kando ya shina.

Baada ya maua huja maganda yaliyosimama yenye pande nne, yaliyojaa mbegu ndogo bapa. Yakiiva na kukauka, maganda hupasuka, kwa hiyo zao lazima livunwe kwa wakati unaofaa.

Wakulima wa Kidigo hulima aina mbili zenye majina, *ufuha mwiru* na *ufuha mwereru*.
about.dg:
*Ufuha* ni mmea uimao chocho, na unakula hadi kufika chiasi cha chitswa cha mutu. Una makodza laini, na maruwa ga umbo ra kengele, ganayohalana na mridza, mereru au ga pinki ngushu-ngushu, ganayomera kanda-kanda ya mlitawe.

Bada ya maruwa kunatuluka makakaya ganayoima chocho, ga pembe nne, ganayoodzala tembe ndide sambamba. Gachiivwa na kuuma, makakaya higa ganaahuka, kpwa hivyo ni lazima ufuha ukatwe kpwa wakati unaofwaha.

Akurima Adigo nkurima aina mbiri zenye madzina: *ufuha mwiru* na *ufuha mwereru*.

where.en: Sesame is grown as a cash crop on dry farms, and it copes with heat and little rain.
where.sw: Ufuta hulimwa kama zao la biashara katika mashamba makavu, na huvumilia joto na mvua chache.
where.dg: *Ufuha* nkurimwa kpwa kuguzwa kpwenye minda ya tsi kavu, na unavumirira dzoho na mvula chache.

uses.en: The seeds are pressed for cooking oil and used in sweets and snacks. Sesame is also sold for cash income.
uses.sw: Mbegu hukamuliwa mafuta ya kupikia na hutumika katika peremende na vitafunio. Ufuta pia huuzwa ili kupata mapato.
uses.dg: Tembeze nkubanwa ili zilavye mafuha ga kujitira, na nkuhumirwa kpwenye peremende na vyakurya vidide. *Ufuha* piya nkuguzwa ili kuphaha pesa.

names.en: Digo: *ufuha*. Swahili: *ufuta*. English: sesame or simsim. Scientists call it *Sesamum orientale* (also known as *S. indicum*).
names.sw: Kidigo: *ufuha*. Kiswahili: *ufuta*. Kiingereza: *sesame* au *simsim*. Wanasayansi huuita *Sesamum orientale* (pia hujulikana kama *S. indicum*).
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *ufuha*. Kpwa Chiswahili: *ufuta*. Kpwa Chingereza: *sesame* au *simsim*. Kpwa sayansi unaihwa *Sesamum orientale* (piya unamanyikana kpwa dzina *S. indicum*).

reason.en: Wild sesame, a close relative eaten as a leafy vegetable
reason.sw: Ufuta pori, jamaa wa karibu anayeliwa kama mboga ya majani
reason.dg: *Mrenda* wa weruni, ndugu wa phephi wa *ufuha*; makodzage nkuriwa dza mboga.

reason.en: Groundnut, another oily seed of sandy farms
reason.sw: Karanga, mbegu nyingine yenye mafuta ya mashamba ya mchanga
reason.dg: Njugu karanga, tembe yanjina yenye mafuha ya minda ya mtsanga.

reason.en: Cashew, the main crop sold for income
reason.sw: Mkorosho, zao kuu linalouzwa kupata mapato
reason.dg: Ngorosho, mmea mkulu unaoguzwa ili kuphaha pesa.

reason.sw: Zao lingine la biashara la mashamba makavu
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina wa kuguza wa minda ya tsi kavu.
